title: Azure Nikah

couple.tagline: The Auspicious Royal Nikah Celebration Of
couple.invitationMessage: With the divine grace of Almighty Allah (SWT) and the cherished prayers of our beloved parents and elders, we cordially invite you to celebrate the sacred bond of Nikah as our children unite their destinies.
couple.urduGreeting: Aapki pur-khuloos shirkat aur duayein hamari khushiyon ko dobala karengi.

venue.name: The Royal Azure Lake Palace
venue.address: Pichola Waterfront Heritage Estate, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001

storyMessage: Underneath a celestial midnight sky shimmering with crescent stars and sapphire reflections upon the water, our destiny was written by the Most Merciful. With the loving prayers of our parents and elders, we unite our lives in the sacred covenant of Nikah.

events.name: Jashn-e-Qawwali, Manjha & Sangeet Night
events.location: The Royal Azure Lake Palace, Udaipur
events.description: An ethereal starlight evening of marigold showers, fragrant ubtan, and soul-stirring Sufi qawwali melodies celebrating family harmony.

events.name: The Sacred Nikah Ceremony (Ijab-o-Qubool)
events.location: The Royal Azure Lake Palace, Udaipur
events.description: The sacred marriage covenant solemnized amidst the recitation of holy verses, Khutbah-e-Nikah, and the heartfelt prayers of respected elders.

events.name: Rukhsati & Grand Dawat-e-Walima Gala
events.location: The Royal Azure Lake Palace, Udaipur
events.description: Tender parental prayers under the shadow of the Quran followed by a magnificent royal banquet celebrating love, honor, and the union of two families.

verse.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
verse.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
verse.propheticDua: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
verse.propheticDuaTranslation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness and eternal love.
